whoItsFor: Teams and individuals who want a self-hosted, industry-specific news site (such as law, HR, finance, or precious metals) with their own sources and curation standards. Developers who can adapt the source list and selection prompts to their domain will get the most out of it.
useCases: Run a self-hosted daily news site that collects, filters, and scores articles from sources you choose
Build an industry hot-topics site by swapping in your own sources, selection criteria, and prompts
Publish automated daily, weekly, and monthly digests, and expose the content via RSS, API, and MCP for agents
